evidence.topic: LibreDWG's DWG writer claims are version- and source-specific
evidence.observed: The project README says R2010-R2018 writing still leads to CRC/audit problems and excludes R2007. Generated dwgwrite help says only R2000 for now but lists later version tokens as valid and R2007 as planned. NEWS announces the R2004 encoder in 0.14.1 and says R2007 encoding falls back to R2010. The closed 0.14 milestone describes a goal of writing 2004-2018 except 2007. The release page lists nightly 0.14.8612 at commit f860b0f on 2026-10-13. These statements differ in scope and maturity; no output was generated or independently validated in this pass.
doesNotEstablish: that a recognized CLI target token produces a valid DWG
that R2007 fallback output is valid or semantically equivalent
that R2010-R2018 output passes CRC, audit, or native acceptance
entity/object completeness, owner closure, or ACIS/AcDs semantics
evidence.planDisposition: At most, admit the exact released R2004 encoder as an optional AC1018 candidate producer at the composed gate. Bind exact source/build/artifact, command, output magic/hash and diagnostics; independently validate structure, per-handle identity, ownership and payloads. Do not use modern version-token acceptance or fallback as a positive control.

evidence.topic: Peer version matrices must be narrowed to exact operation and entity route
evidence.observed: ACadSharp v3.8.0's release entry lists assembly visibility only, while its broad public compatibility matrix coexists with current issue reports involving AC1032 INSERTs, TABLE block-cell values, SPLINE conversion and DXF 3DSOLID/REGION omission. The reports are scoped leads, not confirmed defects in every release. IxMilia.Dxf documents DXF R10-R2014 with exclusions for MESH, MLEADER, SURFACE, TABLE and VIEWPORT, and warns that its writer output for ACIS-bearing or incomplete entities may be rejected by AutoCAD. ezdxf documents DXF read/write/new versions through R2018 with older input normalized/upgraded and offers audit/recovery; none of these is a DWG implementation.
doesNotEstablish: current runtime behavior for a specific peer package not executed here
DWG, AcDs, ACIS solid or B-rep support from a DXF compatibility matrix
AutoCAD acceptance from a peer writer's version claim
raw wire preservation from a normalized or audited document
evidence.planDisposition: Keep ACadSharp as optional route-specific structural comparison and IxMilia/ezdxf as optional DXF-only comparators. Pin exact source/artifact/runtime and record operation, version, feature, nested owner route, diagnostics and per-source-record disposition. Do not add peer runtime to the local fast-test loop.
